enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed, fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket up over the body. Closes eyes. Turns the head to the side. Rolls onto the right side. Places the arm under the pillow. Remains lying still on the bed. Rolls onto the back. Turns the head to the other side. Extends the legs under the blanket. Pulls the blanket up to the shoulders. Remains lying still in bed. Rolls onto the left side. Keeps the fan running at the bedside during the night.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Stands up. Walks to the bathroom. Opens the bathroom door. Turns on the bathroom light. Lifts the toilet lid. Sits on the toilet. Stands up. Flushes the toilet. Lowers the toilet lid. Walks to the shower. Turns on the water heater. Turns on the shower tap. Steps under the water. Wets the hair and body. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Pours shampoo into the hand. Rubs shampoo into the hair. Rinses the hair. Picks up the soap. Rubs soap over the body. Rinses the body. Turns off the shower tap. Picks up the towel. Wipes the face. Dries the hair with the towel. Dries the body. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Rinses the mouth with water. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the bathroom door. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet time: checking phone, light stretching, waiting for bathroom to be free
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Closes the bedroom door. Sits on the bed. Picks up the phone from the bedside table. Turns on the phone screen. Scrolls through messages with the thumb. Puts the phone down on the bed. Stands up. Raises both arms above the head. Bends the torso to the left. Bends the torso to the right. Rotates the shoulders backwards. Touches the toes with both hands. Straightens up. Sits down on the bed. Picks up the phone again. Scrolls through the phone screen. Puts the phone down on the bedside table. Stands up. Walks to the bedroom door. Opens the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a holiday breakfast of toast and tea/coffee with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Greets Member 2. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out the bread, butter and milk. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Opens the cupboard. Takes out two plates. Closes the cupboard. Opens the bread bag. Takes out two slices of bread. Places the slices in the toaster. Presses the toaster lever down. Fills the kettle with water. Presses the kettle switch on. Opens the cupboard. Takes out two mugs and two tea bags. Closes the cupboard. Places a tea bag in each mug. Pours hot water from the kettle into the mugs. Takes the toast out of the toaster. Spreads butter on the toast with a knife. Puts the plates on the table. Sits down at the table with Member 2. Picks up a slice of toast. Eats the toast. Picks up the mug. Drinks the tea. Talks with Member 2. Finishes the toast and tea. Stands up from the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading breakfast dishes into the dishwasher with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the plates from the table. Carries the plates to the sink. Scrapes food scraps into the bin. Opens the dishwasher door. Pulls out the bottom rack. Places the plates in the rack. Picks up the mugs from the table. Places the mugs in the rack. Picks up the knives and butter dish. Places them in the rack. Pushes the bottom rack back in. Closes the dishwasher door. Wipes the table with a cloth. Picks up the cloth. Wrings the cloth over the sink. Hangs the cloth on the tap. Turns to Member 2 and says the table is clear.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning tidying up: vacuuming the floor, dusting surfaces and organising the living area
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Picks up cushions from the sofa. Places the cushions back in position. Picks up the remote control from the coffee table. Places the remote control in the drawer. Picks up stray items from the floor. Carries the items to the shelf. Puts the items on the shelf. Opens the cupboard under the TV unit. Pulls out the vacuum cleaner. Plugs the vacuum cleaner cord into the wall socket. Presses the vacuum cleaner switch on. Pushes the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pulls the vacuum cleaner back. Moves the vacuum cleaner along the sofa edge. Lifts the vacuum cleaner over the rug. Pushes the vacuum cleaner under the coffee table. Pulls the vacuum cleaner out. Presses the vacuum cleaner switch off. Pulls the plug out of the wall socket. Wraps the cord around the vacuum cleaner. Puts the vacuum cleaner back in the cupboard. Closes the cupboard door. Picks up the duster. Wipes the television screen. Wipes the top of the TV unit. Wipes the shelf surfaces. Puts the duster back in the cupboard. Stands back in the middle of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk with the lamp on, checking emails and personal messages on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Pulls the desk chair out. Sits down on the desk chair. Presses the desk lamp switch on. Moves the mouse to wake the computer. Types the password on the keyboard. Presses Enter. Opens the email application. Clicks on the first email. Reads the email. Clicks reply. Types a reply on the keyboard. Clicks send. Opens the next email. Reads the email. Clicks on the next email. Types a reply. Clicks send. Opens the personal messages application. Types a message on the keyboard. Presses Enter. Reads the incoming reply. Types another message. Presses Enter. Scrolls down the message list. Opens a message. Types a response. Presses Enter. Closes the message window. Moves the mouse to the email window. Clicks on the last email. Reads the email. Closes the email application. Presses the desk lamp switch off. Pushes the desk chair back. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a simple lunch with ingredients from the refrigerator and using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out vegetables, eggs and a container of leftover rice. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a pan and a plate. Closes the cupboard. Turns on the tap. Washes the vegetables under the water. Turns off the tap. Places the vegetables on the chopping board. Picks up a knife. Cuts the vegetables into pieces. Places the knife down. Presses the induction cooker power button on. Pours oil into the pan. Places the pan on the induction cooker. Picks up the vegetables. Puts the vegetables into the pan. Picks up a spatula. Stirs the vegetables with the spatula. Picks up the eggs. Cracks the eggs on the edge of the pan. Pours the eggs into the pan. Stirs the mixture with the spatula. Pours the rice into the pan. Stirs the mixture. Presses the induction cooker power button off. Picks up the plate. Spoons the food onto the plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch at the table and cleaning the counter afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Carries the plate to the table. Sits down at the table. Picks up the fork. Eats the food from the plate. Picks up the glass of water. Drinks the water. Continues eating with the fork. Finishes the food on the plate. Stands up from the table. Carries the plate and glass to the sink. Turns on the tap. Rinses the plate and glass. Turns off the tap. Opens the dishwasher door. Pulls out the bottom rack. Places the plate and glass in the rack. Pushes the rack in. Closes the dishwasher door. Picks up the cloth. Wipes the counter with the cloth. Rinses the cloth under the tap. Wrings the cloth out. Hangs the cloth on the tap. Wipes the table with a second cloth. Pushes the chair back under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local park, strolling along the paths and sitting on a bench enjoying the spring afternoon
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the keys from the hook. Picks up the phone from the table. Puts the phone in the pocket. Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes the front door. Locks the front door with the key. Puts the keys in the pocket. Walks along the footpath to the end of the street. Turns right at the corner. Crosses the road at the crossing. Walks along the path towards the park. Enters the park through the gate. Walks along the paved path. Passes the pond. Continues along the path. Turns left at the fork. Walks past the playground. Reaches the bench. Sits down on the bench. Places both hands on the knees. Looks ahead. Crosses the legs. Uncrosses the legs. Leans back on the bench. Puts the arms on the backrest. Stands up from the bench. Walks back along the path. Exits the park through the gate. Turns left towards the shops.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local supermarket for the coming week's food supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the supermarket. Picks up a shopping basket by the entrance. Carries the basket down the first aisle. Picks up a bag of pasta. Places the pasta in the basket. Picks up a jar of sauce. Places the jar in the basket. Walks to the next aisle. Picks up a bag of rice. Places the rice in the basket. Picks up a loaf of bread. Places the bread in the basket. Walks to the vegetable section. Picks up a bag of potatoes. Places the potatoes in the basket. Picks up onions and carrots. Places them in the basket. Picks up a bag of apples. Places the apples in the basket. Walks to the dairy section. Opens the chiller door. Takes out a carton of milk. Closes the chiller door. Places the milk in the basket. Takes out a tub of yoghurt. Places the yoghurt in the basket. Walks to the checkout. Places the basket on the counter. Picks the items out of the basket. Places the items on the counter. Picks up the phone. Opens the payment application. Scans the payment code at the terminal. Puts the phone in the pocket. Picks up the shopping bags. Picks up the receipt from the terminal. Puts the receipt in the pocket. Walks out of the supermarket.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from the shops with groceries
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the shopping bags from the ground. Holds a bag in each hand. Walks along the footpath away from the supermarket. Crosses the road at the crossing. Walks up the street. Adjusts the grip on the bags. Shifts a bag from the right hand to the left hand. Walks past the park entrance. Turns right at the corner. Walks to the front door. Puts the bags down on the ground. Takes the keys out of the pocket. Unlocks the front door. Picks up the bags. Opens the front door. Steps inside. Closes the front door. Locks the front door. Puts the keys back on the hook. Carries the bags into the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer to draft the outline for an upcoming community program and volunteer roster
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Pulls the desk chair out. Sits down. Presses the desk lamp switch on. Moves the mouse to wake the computer. Opens the word processing application. Types a heading on the keyboard. Presses Enter. Types the first section heading. Presses Enter. Types the bullet points under the heading. Presses Enter. Types the next section heading. Presses Enter. Types the bullet points. Opens the spreadsheet application. Types the volunteer names in the first column. Presses Tab. Types the shift times in the second column. Presses Tab. Types the roles in the third column. Presses Enter. Types the next volunteer row. Presses Enter. Types the next volunteer row. Saves the file by pressing Ctrl and S. Switches back to the word processing window. Types an additional paragraph. Saves the document again. Closes the applications. Presses the desk lamp switch off. Pushes the desk chair back. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner with Member 2 using the induction cooker and oven, range hood running
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out meat, vegetables and cheese. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a baking tray and a pan. Closes the cupboard. Presses the oven power button on. Turns the oven dial to the setting. Presses the range hood switch on. Turns on the tap. Washes the vegetables under the water. Turns off the tap. Places the vegetables on the chopping board. Picks up a knife. Cuts the vegetables into pieces. Picks up the meat. Places the meat on the tray. Picks up the vegetables. Places the vegetables on the tray. Sprinkles salt over the tray. Places the tray in the oven. Closes the oven door. Presses the induction cooker power button on. Pours oil into the pan. Places the pan on the induction cooker. Picks up the chopped ingredients. Puts them in the pan. Picks up a spatula. Stirs the ingredients with the spatula. Talks with Member 2 about the cooking order. Picks up the oven mitts. Opens the oven door. Pulls the tray out. Places the tray on the counter. Closes the oven door.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up two plates from the cupboard. Places the plates on the counter. Spoons food from the pan onto the plates. Carries the plates to the table. Places the plates on the table. Carries the tray to the table. Picks up the cutlery from the drawer. Places the cutlery beside the plates. Sits down at the table with Member 2. Picks up the fork and knife. Cuts the food. Eats the food. Talks with Member 2 about the day. Picks up the glass of water. Drinks the water. Places the glass down on the table. Continues eating. Finishes the food on the plate. Places the fork and knife down on the plate. Leans back in the chair. Picks up the glass. Drinks the rest of the water. Stands up from the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping down the benches
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the plates from the table. Carries the plates to the sink. Scrapes the food scraps into the bin. Opens the dishwasher door. Pulls out the bottom rack. Places the plates in the rack. Picks up the cutlery from the table. Places the cutlery in the cutlery basket. Picks up the glasses. Places the glasses in the rack. Picks up the serving tray. Places the tray in the rack. Pushes the bottom rack in. Closes the dishwasher door. Picks up a cloth. Wipes the table with the cloth. Picks up the second cloth. Wipes the benches with the cloth. Rinses the cloth under the tap. Wrings the cloth out. Hangs the cloth on the tap. Turns to Member 2 and says the kitchen is done.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with Member 2: watching television and playing a game on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Sits down on the sofa next to Member 2. Picks up the remote control from the coffee table. Presses the TV power button. Points the remote at the TV. Presses the channel buttons. Places the remote control on the coffee table. Picks up a game controller from the shelf. Hands the second controller to Member 2. Presses the controller power button on. Presses the buttons on the controller. Moves the joystick with the thumb. Presses the shoulder buttons. Talks with Member 2 about the game. Leans forward on the sofa. Presses the buttons again. Moves the joystick. Pauses the game. Picks up the glass from the coffee table. Drinks the water. Places the glass down. Resumes the game. Presses the buttons on the controller. Laughs and speaks to Member 2. Finishes the round. Places the controller on the coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a film on television
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the remote control from the coffee table. Presses the streaming application button. Scrolls through the film list with the arrow buttons. Presses the select button on a film. Places the remote control on the coffee table. Leans back on the sofa. Watches the television screen. Adjusts the cushion behind the back. Crosses the legs. Uncrosses the legs. Picks up the glass from the coffee table. Drinks the water. Places the glass down. Watches the television screen. Stretches the arms above the head. Puts the arms down. Picks up the remote control. Presses the volume button. Places the remote control on the coffee table. Watches the television screen. Picks up the remote control. Presses the pause button. Stands up from the sofa. Walks to the kitchen. Returns with a snack. Sits down on the sofa. Presses the play button. Watches the television screen. Eats the snack. Presses the stop button when the film ends. Presses the TV power button off. Places the remote control on the coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash: showering, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the bathroom. Opens the bathroom door. Turns on the bathroom light. Picks up the towel from the rail. Hangs the towel on the hook. Turns on the water heater. Turns on the shower tap. Steps under the water. Wets the hair and body. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Pours shampoo into the hand. Rubs shampoo into the hair. Rinses the hair. Picks up the soap. Rubs soap over the body. Rinses the body. Turns off the shower tap. Picks up the towel. Dries the hair. Dries the body. Wraps the towel around the body. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Rinses the mouth with water. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns off the water heater. Turns off the bathroom light. Opens the bathroom door. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed browsing the phone and winding down with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Closes the bedroom door. Presses the fan switch on. Pulls the blanket back. Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket up over the legs. Picks up the phone from the bedside table. Turns on the phone screen. Scrolls through the news feed with the thumb. Opens a video. Watches the video on the phone. Scrolls to the next video. Presses the like button. Continues scrolling with the thumb. Opens a message. Types a short reply. Presses send. Puts the phone down on the bedside table. Turns onto the right side. Pulls the blanket up to the shoulders.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies still on the bed. Closes eyes. Keeps the fan running at the bedside. Rolls onto the back. Places the arms beside the body. Turns the head to the side. Rolls onto the left side. Pulls the blanket up over the shoulder. Remains lying still in bed.
